scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:app
scripts.build:styles: mkdir -p static/styles && cp src/shared/styles/*.css src/modules/analysis/ui/setup/*.css src/modules/results/ui/workspace/*.css src/modules/results/ui/summary/*.css src/modules/results/ui/player/*.css static/styles/
scripts.check:functions: bun --config=bunfig.domain.toml test --coverage src/modules/analysis/domain src/modules/results/domain src/modules/sharing/domain src/modules/analysis/application src/modules/results/application src/modules/sharing/application src/modules/results/ui/shortcuts.test.ts src/modules/results/ui/playback-rate.test.ts src/modules/results/ui/debug/debug-viewer-model.test.ts src/modules/results/ui/summary/damage-origin-format.test.ts
scripts.build:notices: mkdir -p static && cp ../DATA_NOTICE.md static/DATA_NOTICE.txt && cp ../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md static/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt
scripts.build:outputs: run-p build:html build:styles build:notices build:images build:wasmcopy build:bundle build:worker
